citation.title: Integrated operation scenarios: Chapter 6 of the special issue: on the path to tokamak burning plasma operation
citation.authors: Na Y.-S., Schuster E., Budny R.V., Garofalo A.M., Hahn S.-H., Kim H.-T., Koechl F., Polevoi A.R., et al. and ITPA Integrated Operation Scenario topical group

topic: ITPA review of ITER operation scenarios, actuators, and model-based scenario control, including observers and real-time estimation
own_question: What progress has been made since 2007 on ITER plasma initiation, low-activation, baseline, hybrid, and steady-state scenarios, actuators, and control?
actual_method_and_evidence: This is a narrative multi-device review of experiments, code benchmarks, and integrated modeling. It contains no CES Ti nowcasting, no BES/ECEI-based estimation, and no KSTAR pedestal-top impurity-temperature evaluation. Section 8.3 discusses control-oriented models, dynamic state observers that combine predictive models with diagnostics, and real-time forecasting. The review describes these as concepts and cites examples; it does not establish performance for our task.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reviews of tokamak control describe dynamic state observers that combine fast predictive models with diagnostic data to estimate plasma states between measurements.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Section 8.3.2, Observers bullet (PDF p.97); Section 8.5.2, diagnostic interface layer
claim_checks.qualification: This is general control context. It is not evidence that ion-temperature nowcasting is useful or feasible. The cited observer examples cover density, q, and Te, not CES Ti.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The review contains no CES report timing or arrival-time data.
forbidden_inferences: That ITER requires CES Ti nowcasting
That reviewed observers validate our estimator
That prior work lacks causal Ti estimation
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional single background citation for observer and real-time estimation context in plasma control. It is otherwise off-topic for our paper.
